newsitem.title: USA: N. Colonie, N.Y., weighs $26 mln school bond - paper.
newsitem.headline: N. Colonie, N.Y., weighs $26 mln school bond - paper.

text.p: North Colonie, N.Y., school officials plan to discuss on Monday night a $25.9 million renovation of all district schools that voters would have to approve in January, the Albany Times Union said on Monday.
The measure, which would be included in a special January 29 referendum, also includes upgrading the district's athletic playing fields.

The Board of Education, which is reviewing the plan, will not decide which projects to include until getting more information from the community, the paper said. As a result, the board is not yet sure how much the bond would cost taxpayers.
The paper noted that the South Colonie Board of Education last month unveiled a $19.9 million renovation project for district schools.
This proposal is expected to be taken up at the board's November 12 meeting and perhaps set a tax-rate estimate to pay for the work, the paper quoted a district official as saying.
